name: Iridic-Reliquary
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dust seas stretching to the horizon and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
